title: One Journey or Circle can be listed across member Spaces and partner Collectives
detail: PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on event sharing. Dated after Founding Collective launch.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(!fs.existsSync("lib/collective/cross-listing.ts"))fail("no cross-listing module");console.log("ok: cross-listing exists")'
